claim: The current local and serial descriptions overlap. This is not universal equivalence, impossibility of authoring, or a requirement for an already confirmed lexical anchor.
exact_scope_correction: The relevant scope predecessor is IDEA000866, not GDT866 (the latter is an unrelated upper-link observation).
Local scene reset does not assert that two depicted instances are different actual persons. Serial persistence does not yet require any later expression to consume carried information.

The local contract permits a properly written nonlocal construction. Therefore finding a cross-panel-looking expression cannot reject the broad local family unless its exact shared grammar and resolver are frozen.

constructive_overlap.finite_contract: Two scene environments E1={x1}, E2={x2}; two source-level clauses P(local_figure), one per scene. These are invented logical clauses, not transcriptions or assignments to native forms. P has one fixed unary meaning in both scenes.
constructive_overlap.world: Domain={a,c}; P={a}. Both depicted variables may denote a because no cross-panel distinct-person premise is given. This is an informative predicate: changing P(a) to false changes both assertions, so the example is not a self-equality or universal truth.
constructive_overlap.local: At the second panel discard E1, create E2 and resolve local_figure to x2; both clauses assert P(a).
constructive_overlap.serial: Retain a as the prior participant, and either keep selecting the locally licensed a or let the fixed default select that carried a. Both clauses again assert P(a).
constructive_overlap.conclusion: There exists a complete content-bearing common interpretation with the same predicate and the same written clauses for both modes. Two valid accounts or four matching scene pictures therefore cannot by themselves select one mode. This does not show all possible local and serial accounts coincide.

unused_state_lemma.assumptions: A serial machine is allowed to retain an extra finite register, but no later writer action, resolver, acceptance condition or reported consequence reads it. All other operations equal the local machine.
unused_state_lemma.proof: Run both machines on the same finite record sequence. Induction gives the same visible output, emitted assertions and acceptance after every step, since the only unequal component is never read. Keeping it is observationally inert.
unused_state_lemma.boundary: A required read, global identity assertion, cardinality condition, state-dependent prediction or independently specified semantic cost can break this equivalence. A general penalty for hidden registers would be a model-selection convention, not evidence that the historical writer reset.

smallest_genuine_discriminator.candidate: One written producer before a panel boundary and one obligatory consumer after it, under a common frozen parser, value type and reference rule.
smallest_genuine_discriminator.example: A first record explicitly produces a Result value v into named slot r. After the boundary, a later parsed expression is USE(r), whose argument cannot be supplied by any pictured Person/Apparatus variable. In this fixed pair of models LOCAL resets the Result store; SERIAL preserves it. USE has no literal/default/import branch, and there is no intervening producer, rebinding or update.
smallest_genuine_discriminator.consequences: SERIAL resolves USE to the earlier v; LOCAL fails its required argument. If LOCAL is enlarged with a written IMPORT or a different USE meaning, that is another rival, not the same failed fixed local model. If SERIAL may decline persistence or choose another value, its contract was not yet fixed.
smallest_genuine_discriminator.reverse_or_truth_contrast: A fixed RESET instruction or incompatible same-state assertion can reject a stipulated persistence law instead. For a property contrast P(a) versus NOT P(resolve r), the referent, state/time, condition, polarity and lack of intervening update must all be fixed; silence is not negation.
smallest_genuine_discriminator.anchor_policy: The producer/consumer interpretation may be authored as an explicit candidate before any meaning is confirmed. It must use the existing word-profile/evidence rules before actual native assignments, retain counterexamples, and expose its commitments. Conditional discrimination of two such grammars is possible; it is not independent confirmation of either grammar.

whole_page_investment_decision: First author one prospective cross-boundary producer-consumer chain inside the already fixed full-page scope, including the exact consumer rule and both rivals. If it derives unequal obligations without free reference choices, complete both whole-page accounts and their remaining costs. Do not start by purchasing unrelated full dictionaries for every record and only then looking for a discriminator. Full-page obligations are retained; the chain is a design checkpoint, not a selected favorable excerpt replacing the page.
